name: Trina Solar Co., Ltd.
summary: Trina Solar Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sales of photovoltaic (PV) modules in China, Europe, North and Latin America, the United States, Japan, the Asia Pacific, the Middle East, and Africa. It offers silicon photovoltaic modules and monocrystalline silicon solar cells. The company also provides solutions, such as solar modules, energy storage products, photovoltaic brackets, and other products, and inverters.
